name: Arrow Blocks
summary: Adds a clear arrow to hoppers, droppers, dispensers and observers that points where items or the redstone signal come out.
logoPrompt: A chunky grey cobblestone dropper block seen from a three-quarter angle, with a bold dark arrow carved into its top face pointing towards its front

cover.tagline: See which way your redstone blocks face.

description: **Arrow Blocks paints a small arrow on hoppers, droppers, dispensers and observers, so you see which way each one pushes items or sends its signal.**
- A hopper that feeds sideways shows an arrow on the floor of its bowl, pointing at its spout. A hopper that drops straight down shows a small ring there instead.
- Droppers and dispensers carry arrows on the top, the bottom and both sides, all pointing towards the front they shoot from.
- Observers keep their vanilla arrow on top and get matching arrows on both sides, pointing to the back where the signal comes out.
- The arrows turn with the block, also when it faces up or down.
Put the zip into the `resourcepacks` folder of your game, then turn it on under Options > Resource Packs. Place the blocks as usual.
- Made for Minecraft: Java Edition 1.21, 1.21.1 and 26.3. The arrows are drawn onto the vanilla textures in the same grey pixel style.
- Furnaces stay unchanged, even though droppers and dispensers borrow their stone textures.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
